Existing reader_receipts executes original HARV UnitType/Rules/MissionControl constructors and selected original key readers over physical RULESMD, optional LANGRULE, MPBattleMD and XMP03T4 lexical strings, in that order. Harvester default0 becomes1. Physical file loading and index construction are supplied; no Rust-derived type values are used.

Original UnitReady/Commence promotes AreaGuard; Mission5B3060 dispatches through unchanged Unit744100 to Foot4D6AA0. Keyboard selection, G input voice/OutList delivery and whole Logic scheduling are outside this corpus.

Both skirmish human and computer houses and ore/clear land are supplied. No SlaveManager, bunker, building-entry flag, active navigation list or archived allied-building collision is supplied, so those earlier independent arms are not certified. Original heads execute.

One already-current AreaGuard control supplies Unit unloading+6D1, target, destination and archive; original Ready744270 refuses, but original Foot calls Commence directly. The unloading producer and that cross-state history are excluded. Another control visits before and exactly at the original retained dispatch deadline.

Native RandomRanged1..10 rejection and raw draw order execute; no cadence/queue/commence result is supplied. Original text and Unit vtable bytes are checked unchanged after each history.

The branch leaves target, navigation, archive, cargo and harvesting/unloading latches intact, resets the mission cursor through Commence and writes its returned delay through the shared dispatcher. No subsequent Harvest dispatch, movement, ore collection, refinery return or rendered output is claimed by these six controls.

Inherited map reachability, recalculation, radar, sound, dock and animation service boundaries remain as recorded by the existing fixture.
